sections.title: Honors Thesis Program
sections.description: The thesis program is offered to a select group of students who apply and qualify through two rounds of assessment, comprising typically 6-10 students. The summer and fall semester serve to develop research of interests individual to students, with the help of faculty advisors, who critique individually and as a group in a workshop format. Design projects are developed in the spring semester. Besides final reviews, students are expected to document their work in a book format.
